response.original_title: Agatha Christie's Poirot: Five Little Pigs
response.overview: The daughter of an artist, who was executed 14 years earlier, asks Hercule Poirot to prove that her mother was not guilty of the crime.
response.tagline: The truth has a habit of making itself known. Even after many years.
response.title: Agatha Christie's Poirot: Five Little Pigs
